title: Choose ShellFlow's look · the familiar end
question: Three calmer looks from MFE's own world, plus the standard one. The layout you know stays the same. If none is right, type what is missing in the box (for example: more gold, darker, simpler) before re-rolling.

options.label: Drawing Set
options.lineage: Architectural drawing sheets: title blocks, sheet numbers, revision triangles
options.thesis: Every page carries a title block like a drawing sheet, and a revised figure wears a revision triangle until it is approved.
options.viewport: The same header and menu; the page head becomes a boxed title block with sheet, revision and approver, and changed values carry a red revision triangle.
options.risk: Speaks most to the design team; others may see it as a CAD screen.

options.label: Fair-Face Concrete
options.lineage: Architectural fair-face precast: smooth grey panels, joint lines, tie holes
options.thesis: Quiet concrete greys with a verdigris accent; each step's tie holes fill in as its gate conditions are met.
options.viewport: The same header and menu on concrete grey; four tie holes on each step fill as its conditions are met.
options.risk: Grey on grey can turn dull or low-contrast, so text stays near-black and the accent has to work hard.

options.label: Sales Gallery Model
options.lineage: Developer sales galleries: white architectural models on plinths
options.thesis: Crisp model-white surfaces with a basswood accent; blocks show as white massing models whose floors warm as they complete.
options.viewport: The same header and menu in white; the valuation side shows the three blocks as small massing models, completed floors in basswood.
options.risk: White on white is where many premium screens land; it needs firm edges to stay readable.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Built to sit beside Procore, Linear and Stripe's dashboard: white, slate greys, one blue accent, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: The same header, menu and form, in the familiar enterprise look.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other systems by design; the luxury lives only in finish.
